summary.text: Suleman Lalani is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 76 who has served since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Linda Howell is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Suleman Lalani's career experience includes working as a doctor.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Lalani said his practice was geriatric medicine and that his experience seeing patients with preventable ailments led him to focus on healthcare and its economic impact.
Lalani ran for Texas House District 26 in 2020, advancing from the Democratic primary to a runoff that L. Sarah DeMerchant won.
He won the 2022 Democratic primary runoff for District 76 and, according to Ballotpedia, assumed office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Claudia Ordaz.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Natural Resources, House Higher Education and Resolutions Calendars.
He defeated Marie Baptiste in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the 2022 survey, Lalani named expanding healthcare as his top goal, along with long-term funding for public education and a $15 minimum wage tied to a cost-of-living index.
